metadata.title: A very special food Goduk cooked by Koloi/Kalai tribe | त्रिपुरा की कोलोई ट्राइब का ख़ास भोजन
metadata.description: Kalai or Koloi is one of the indigenous groups of the 19 Scheduled tribes in the state of Tripura. This community is a sub tribe of Halam indigenous group. This tribe speak kokborok language and known for a very rich cultural heritage. This community is blessed with wonderful variety of food. Peculiar, bland, hot, aromatic, healthy food is cooked by the people of Koloi tribe.
